regression_findings.finding: C5 output loop excluded its repeated endpoint.
Optional crop controls treated null, booleans, arrays and whitespace as numbers.
C2/C6 scene probes did not use the corresponding active contour/arc probe.
Annulus surface rectangles and output curves needed selected-domain containment.
Unrepresentable log-only samples needed suppression of false output-zero markers.

Peak-ring, isolated and known rational zeros are omitted in log height; uncertain Laurent rectangles use a conservative analytic polynomial nonzero certificate. Independent fixed Laurent roots calibrate omission.
The C6 linear reciprocal integrand is nonzero at 0 and must not inherit the C4 linear named-function zero.
Eigenstate n1->6, mix0->2 and mix1->1 are impossible outcomes; each restores projection none and preserves complete preparation data/geometry.

reported_limitations.finding: Finite facets approximate functions between mesh samples. Laurent derivative certificates may omit nonzero rectangles because they certify sufficient nonzero conditions and do not claim roots exist.
reported_limitations.numerical_audit_contract: Emitted vertices, selected-domain/pole/discontinuity containment, exact named-zero loci and conservative Laurent nonzero certificates are checked; this audit does not prove holomorphy, a global theorem or exact continuous surface coverage.
